To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the velocity and temperature profiles are significantly influenced by the magnetic field, suction, injection and the parameter describing the viscoelasticity of the fluid.
the velocity and temperature of the fluid are reduced by an increasing magnetic field.

the magnetic field has a stabilizing effect on the Couette flow and the temperature field, the parameter that describes the non-Newtonia behavior has an accelerating effect on the flow field but a decelerating effect on the temperature field, and the velocity and temperature profiles increase as the velocity of injection increases and decrease as the velocity of suction increases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the unsteady MHD Couette flow and heat transfer of an electrically-conducting viscoelastic fluid.
the unsteady MHD Couette flow of a viscoelastic fluid.
the unsteady magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) Couette flow of a viscoelastic fluid with heat transfer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the effect of the magnetic parameter is to reduce the velocity of the fluid and the temperature of the plates, whereas the effect of the non-Newtonain parameter is to increase the velocity and temperature of the plates.
the magnetic field has a significant effect on the temperature and velocity profiles.

the magnetic field and the parameter describing the viscoelasticity have a significant effect on the velocity distribution, but a negligible effect on the temperature distribution, while the velocity of the suction and injection has an important effect on both distributions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the magnetic field has a retarding effect on the fluid velocity while the velocity of the suction and injection has an enhancing effect on the velocity.
for a given value of the magnetic field parameter the velocity and temperature of the viscoelastic fluid are higher than that of a Newtonian fluid.
the non-Newtonan parameter and the magnetic field parameter have a stabilizing effect on the flow.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the non-Newtonianness of the fluid has a significant influence on the flow and heat transfer characteristics.
the non-Newtonians effects are more pronounced for a viscoelastic fluid than a Newtonian fluid.
the magnetic field, suction and injection, and the parameter describing non-Newtonian behaviour all have significant effects on the flow and heat transfer.
